title: Cochain left-unit square for section-normalized adic reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, schemes X and Y with l invertible on both, a scheme isomorphism g:X → Y, native realizations R,S, ambient tensor structures A,B, a coefficient-ring reindexing r, and V:ReindexTensor l X g A B r [def-sf-native-adic-tensor-reindexing]. Let P be a cochain complex of S-modules. Choose chain isomorphisms bB:Tot(OY,P) ≅ P and bA:Tot(OX,F(P)) ≅ F(P), where OX,OY are the coefficient-unit complexes in degree zero and F is the termwise module reindexing. Assume each b acts on its (0,n) homogeneous tensor of the unit section a and a section x by multiplication a·x. Then F(bB.hom) equals V.cochain.hom at (OY,P), followed by Tot(V.unitCochain.hom,id), followed by bA.hom. No K-flatness of P and no comparison between common-stage realizations is assumed.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, with Stacks Tags 03EK and 0FPT; agent-written pure-section and localization verification of the normalized ordinary left unitor.

proof.text: Precompose the desired equality by the inverse cochain tensor comparison. The proved total_hom_ext and pure_ext helpers reduce it to totalization summands and sheafified pure tensors. The coefficient-unit complex is zero away from degree zero, reindexing preserves zero objects, and tensoring preserves zero objects. Thus every summand whose first degree is nonzero vanishes.

For the (0,n) summand, use the single-complex identification to express its first section as the coefficient-unit section of a. The recorded pure-section equation identifies the inverse cochain tensor map on this generator, by applying its inverse to that equation and cancelling the isomorphism. Naturality of total-tensor summand inclusions and the componentwise formula for sheaf pure tensors carry Tot(unitCochain.hom,id) to the map on its first factor. Use the already proved tensorGenerator_map helper of the scalar-unit module for the total generator formula, instead of repeating its proof.

Apply the two assumed multiplication formulas for bB and bA, and the recorded unit-section equation. The source side is multiplication by a. On the target side, the unit comparison sends a to r.iso(a); the definition of modulePull restricts scalars along the inverse of this ring isomorphism. Its action is therefore multiplication by the original a as well. The ring isomorphism identity proves equality, without any nonzero-ring assumption or global generation assumption. Combine with the vanishing summands.

theorem reindexing_left_unitor_chain
    (P : CochainComplex (modules l Y S) ℤ)
    (bB : (coefficientTotalTensor.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S)).obj
      (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S), P) ≅ P)
    (bA : (coefficientTotalTensor.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R)).obj
      (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R),
        ((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅
      ((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    (hbB : ∀ (n : ℤ) (h : 0 + n = n) (W : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : (ring l Y S).obj.obj W)
      (x : (P.X n).val.obj W),
      (bB.hom.f n).val.app W (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
        (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S)
        (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S))
        P 0 n n h W
        (ringedTensorUnitSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S) W a) x) =
        a • x)
    (hbA : ∀ (n : ℤ) (h : 0 + n = n) (W : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : (ring l X R).obj.obj W)
      (x : ((((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).X n).val.obj W),
      (bA.hom.f n).val.app W (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
        (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R)
        (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R))
        (((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) 0 n n h W
        (ringedTensorUnitSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) W a) x) =
        a • x) :
    ((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map bB.hom =
      V.cochain.hom.app
        (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S), P) ≫
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R)).map
        (X := (((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology Y) (ring l Y S)),
          ((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
        (Y := (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R),
          ((modulePull l X g r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
        (V.unitCochain.hom, 𝟙 _) ≫ bA.hom
